scientific_integrity: Explicit proof and standalone rational checker supplied; the finite checks supplement the infinite-family proof. Self-review only, with independent audit unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the first component of precisely the second exact-arithmetic unpreconditioned CG iterate for specified one-dimensional Poisson matrices and single/two-peak discrete-hat right-hand sides. The one-peak comparison is local in the isolated-source amplitude. Historical priority is not independently certified and a recent nonnegative-CG text remained abstract-only. No floating-point or general right-hand-side guarantee.
title: A parity law for the second conjugate-gradient iterate on discrete Poisson paths
